home.aboutText: I'm a software developer with experience in API integrations, process automation and full-stack development. I like picking apart problems, shipping small working demos, and gradually turning that understanding into real, production-ready systems.

about.title: A bit about me
about.subtitle: Software developer specializing in API integrations, process automation and full-stack development.
about.bio1: I'm a software developer with experience in API integrations, process automation and full-stack development using Python and React. In my current role, I've built production integrations — including Chilexpress, the WhatsApp Business API and Zoho CRM — that improve traceability and standardize commercial workflows.
about.bio2: I focus on scalable, modular architecture and apply good practices around quality, maintainability and continuous improvement in agile environments. I'm currently in my third year of a Computer Engineering degree.

timeline.title: Software Developer — Selec Soluciones Eléctricas
timeline.description: Building production integrations (Chilexpress, WhatsApp Business API, Zoho CRM) that streamline commercial workflows — including a WhatsApp chatbot with automated CRM logging, automated shipping cost calculation, and Zoho CRM process automation via Deluge scripting.

timeline.title: Computer Engineering — Duoc UC
timeline.description: Third year of the Computer Engineering program, building a foundation in programming, data structures and web development.

timeline.title: Python Developer Intern — Pulso Escolar
timeline.description: Automated data analysis workflows in CRM environments using Python, Pandas and NumPy. Evaluated with an outstanding grade at the end of the internship.

timeline.title: Professional Programming Technician — Liceo Arturo Matte Larraín
timeline.description: Completed secondary education with a technical specialization in programming.

awsCertifications.title: AWS Cloud Quest: Cloud Practitioner
awsCertifications.description: Hands-on labs in AWS: EC2 and multi-AZ high availability, Auto Scaling and Application Load Balancer, S3, RDS and read replicas, DynamoDB, EFS, IAM (least privilege) and VPC peering.

awsCertifications.title: AWS Cloud Quest: Generative AI Practitioner
awsCertifications.description: Hands-on generative AI labs on AWS: managed prompts and few-shot prompting with Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management, guardrails with denied topics, knowledge bases (RAG) with multiple S3 data sources, agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Gateway, Lambda and DynamoDB), voice synthesis with Amazon Polly, and AI-assisted development with Amazon Q.
